About Me

I'm Christina, a high school sophomore interested in computer science, cybersecurity, and the ways technology can make information more accessible and trustworthy.

I'm currently building my skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, and web development while exploring cybersecurity and the psychology of misinformation. Outside of coding, I enjoy playing tennis, journaling, reading, and listening to music.

I enjoy creating projects that combine technology with real-world problems and I'm especially interested in using computer science to help people navigate the digital world more safely and confidently.
